_status: [старт] Stage 1 starting corridor (T16, director 2026-11-18). All bounds are starting values, not decisions; change them with a line in docs/balance.md. Rule novice-not-faster: director 2026-11-18 (T16). Stage 2 (T23, director 2026-11-19): expert-brakes and expert-long-hard-slows removed (author rejected the lift in hard corners); expert-drift-holds-speed, expert-drift-used, expert-offroad-time, average-never-drifts added; expert-gap widened to 10-35%. Rule offroad-recovery: director 2026-11-18 (R15b). Stage 2b (T26, director 2026-11-19): average-never-drifts and average-saturation removed (driving is drift-based now); expert-drift-used 40-90%, average-drift-used, drift-required added; expert-gap 3-15%.

corridor.note: average stays on asphalt >= 95% of the time
<= 1 off-road event per lap on easy+medium corners
novice leaves the road on hard corners at least once per lap, else the track is too easy and drift has no purpose
expert 3-15% faster than average: both drift, the expert with cleaner lines (stage 2b)
novice lap >= average lap: leaving the road costs more than braking (pillar 3)
the non-drifting novice is >= 15% slower per lap than the drifting average: drift is required (R22b, pillar 3)
the expert drifts through every long hard corner (hold >= measure.longHoldSeconds) at >= 0.95 vmax: no lift mid-corner (pillar 3, author 2026-11-19); missing = no such corner on the track
the expert drifts 40-90% of the time: medium and hard corners are drift-only (R22b, author 2026-11-19)
the average bot drifts >= 30% of the time: medium and hard corners are drift-only (R22b)
the expert's drift stays on asphalt >= 98% of the time
no wall hits (x at xLimit, R18)
no wall hits (x at xLimit, R18)
R15b feel: after leaving the road on a medium corner at vmax (0.2 beyond the edge) the car is back on asphalt within 1.5 s with full steer to the centre; missing = never
